frame: Z-up; origin at nominal field centre; legacy MuJoCo world coordinates

visual_source.export: Compact procedural visual LOD (rmuc2027_field_scene.py) for pushed package; full beauty blend retained in Library
visual_source.notes: Visual-only LOD; replace with full RMUC2027_MuJoCo_Blender_beauty.blend export for high-detail rendering. Blender NAV_* curves are not used for collision.

collision_source.method: Low-complexity boxes and a 24-sided cylinder from published field dimensions and legacy MuJoCo layout
collision_source.notes: Proxy collision, not a part-level CAD/BRep collision mesh.

known_limitations: Library delivery did not include a directly loadable MuJoCo source tree.
Tunnel shells and small mechanisms are intentionally conservative approximations.
Verify dimensions and clearances against measured field/CAD data before competition use.
